record.title: Direct registered holder of a security
record.sub: Hold the claim or registered title
kv: SEC describes direct registration as the investor's name appearing on the issuer's books, maintained by the issuer or its transfer agent.
An investor elects direct registration for a security whose issuer offers it.
Issuer offers direct registration. Investor meets issuer/transfer-agent onboarding and account requirements. For a DRS transfer, the security and transfer agent are DTC DRS eligible.
This is a direct-registration route; it does not establish that every issuer offers it, that a token ledger is the issuer record, or that the issuer is itself the holder.

sources.label: SEC Investor Bulletin: Holding Your Securities
